messages.content:
Stormtalon (Flying / Electric)

Storm + Eagle's Dominion + Tempest Vortex

A majestic guardian of the skies, Stormtalon commands thunder and wind with effortless grace. Each beat of its radiant wings summons crackling lightning, while the cyclones trailing behind it can scatter armies and reshape the battlefield. Legends say its appearance before a storm heralds both destruction for the wicked and hope for those who endure.
